One progression dimension per session type per week; EARNED may release a step the cadence would otherwise hold or skip a consolidation hold, but never adds more than one step on any dimension in a week, and is unavailable in WALK_JOG, RESTART and RETURN modes.

Every step requires executed comparable sessions without an adverse signal in the gating week; quality/strides activation, block-boundary set increases and ladder steps count executed weeks, never calendar weeks.

Single-run ceiling: no planned run other than the race exceeds the longest completed run of the preceding 30 days by more than one longRunStepMinutes; this applies to long-run steps, RESTART->EASY and WALK_JOG->EASY transitions and return steps; with no completed run in 30 days, the reviewed entry is the start.

When the 30-day reference run is under 50 minutes, the 5-minute step exceeds 10% of it; the step stays response-gated, is disclosed, and is never combined with another single-session increase in the same week.

Strength ADVANCE requires logged target repetitions and minimum logged RIR >= prescribed RIR - 1; otherwise HOLD. EARNED requires minimum logged RIR >= prescribed RIR + 2 on two comparable exposures. Any KNOWN-load repetition or load step requires a logged set record at the current load in the gating week; missing logs hold the dose without regression.
The long run stays <= longRunShareOfWeeklyMinutesMax of planned weekly running in every week, unless the policy is amended to define this ratio as week-1 only.
Transition magnitudes (restart step and switch point, walk/jog exit dose, consolidation reduction, post-event redevelopment) are declared in the policy, not hard-coded.
Repeated adverse responses (two comparable within 14 days at the current dose after any regression) regress one step; a single adverse response holds.
limitations: Step sizes, cadence and consolidation are operational, not evidence-derived optima.
Single-session injury association is observational and distance-based.
Strength progression evidence is from trained lifters over 8 weeks.

requiredRuntimeChanges: D30 r6-program.mjs skeletonOf().rotation and policy operational.rotation.scope: reconcile scope (code rotates accessories only); if close variants of main lifts are added, require same pattern and variant family, ESTABLISH on first exposure and delta review. Implement the rotated-back ceiling rule (condition 4) in strengthDose.

probes.note: Reviewer-authored probes use a DEV_TEST_ONLY authority to observe what approval would allow; all were re-run on the runtime after the coordinator's later runtime-only changes (r6-adaptation 14:11, r6-balanced 14:09, r6-program 14:02 local) with the policy hash unchanged.

retainedGaps: No human, empirical product or clinical validation; queue items wait for the funding trigger.
Exact operational magnitudes (steps, fractions, gap bins, cadences) remain operational choices without direct comparative evidence.
Single-session progression evidence is observational and distance-based.
Recreational 10K/HM and combined run+strength taper evidence is indirect.
Novice strides and true-beginner RIR accuracy lack direct evidence.
Pooling across build labels is an unverified assumption.
Hills, VO2max-calibrated work, marathon/ultra, adolescents, pregnancy/postpartum, elite and clinical return remain out of scope.
Legacy-path findings D05, D06 and the legacy part of D08 come from code inspection, not executed probes.
The full R6 test suite and verify scripts were not run by this reviewer (verify scripts are prohibited).
escalations: Clinical-boundary binding defect (D08/D22): illness- or injury-named interruptions can receive a nonclinical return or restart recipe in the cold, intake and legacy paths. No clinical judgment is requested; the runtime must route these to CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED before R6-NONCLINICAL-RETURN or R6-COLD-START can be enabled.
